question: Does Cursor's sessionStart hook fire again when a conversation is resumed?
wait_for: ([.[] | select(.hook_event_name == "beforeSubmitPrompt") | .conversation_id] | unique) as $u | ([.[] | select(.hook_event_name == "beforeSubmitPrompt")] | length) >= 2 and ($u | length) == 1 and any(.[]; .hook_event_name == "sessionStart" and .conversation_id == ($u | first))

assertion.projection: [.[] | select(.hook_event_name == "beforeSubmitPrompt") | .conversation_id] as $pc | ($pc | unique) as $u | ($u | first) as $target | ([.[] | .hook_event_name] | index("beforeSubmitPrompt")) as $i | {resumed: (($pc | length) >= 2 and ($u | length) == 1), fired: (([.[] | select(.hook_event_name == "sessionStart" and .conversation_id == $target)] | length) > 0), after_resume: ([.[$i + 1:][] | select(.hook_event_name == "sessionStart" and .conversation_id == $target)] | length)}
